ReasoningEffort.description: A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.

description: Parameters for the server-owned clear-and-replace operation.

modelSettings.description: Required for successful clear: model settings resolved for a fresh session. Missing or null input is decoded so the server can preserve authority checks, then refused before creating a durable clear transition.

model.description: An unset model uses ordinary server model-default resolution.

reasoningEffort.description: An unset effort replaces the predecessor's configured effort with no override.

threadId.description: The predecessor currently displayed by the requesting connection.
